meta.name: add-imessage
meta.description: Add iMessage to NanoClaw — one channel, two backends. Local (this Mac's chat.db via the Chat SDK bridge; macOS + Full Disk Access) or Hosted iMessage (via photon.codes — native spectrum-ts with a device-login wizard; any OS, no Mac relay). Triggers on "add imessage", "connect imessage", "add photon", "imessage via photon", "native imessage".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让 NanoClaw 连接 iMessage 通道
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在使用 NanoClaw 并希望接收 iMessage 消息。
copy.tagline_en: Connect iMessage to NanoClaw as a channel
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use NanoClaw and want to receive iMessage messages.

howto.what: 让 Claude 能为 NanoClaw 添加 iMessage 频道：它会复制适配器、注册、安装依赖、构建测试、配置环境变量并重启服务。支持本地或远程两种连接方式。
howto.when: 当你说出 “add imessage”、“connect imessage” 或 “add photon” 等触发词时。

say.text: 帮我添加 iMessage 频道
say.note: 开始配置 iMessage，先选本地还是远程模式。
走远程模式，需要 Photon 服务器地址和 API 密钥。
走本地模式，需要 macOS 和完整磁盘访问权限。

howto.what_en: Adds iMessage channel integration to NanoClaw via the Chat SDK. Copies the adapter from the channels branch, registers it, installs a pinned dependency, builds, tests, configures environment, and restarts the service. Supports local (macOS) or remote (Photon API) modes.
howto.when_en: Triggers on phrases like "add imessage", "connect imessage", "add photon", etc.

say_en.note: Starts iMessage setup, choosing local or remote mode.
Uses remote mode; needs Photon server URL and API key.

say_en.text: Set up iMessage on this Mac
say_en.note: Uses local mode; needs macOS and Full Disk Access.
